# Outcomes

This engagement will empower PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC to drive measurable improvements in their lead pipeline visibility and marketing efficiency. By advancing the depth and automation of Lead-to-AUM (L2A) and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) reporting, the organization will gain actionable insights that enhance decision-making, optimize return on marketing spend, and support long-term business growth.

## Expected Business Outcomes

- **Granular Pipeline Visibility:** Leadership and key stakeholders will benefit from detailed insights into each stage of the client journey, from initial lead generation to assets under management, supporting better resource allocation and targeted marketing efforts.

- **Actionable Marketing ROI Analytics:** The new CAC reporting model will provide precise metrics on the effectiveness of marketing investments, enabling the team to optimize spend and allocate budgets to the highest-performing channels.

- **Automated and Accurate Reporting:** By automating data ingestion, transformation, and report refresh processes, PURE will reduce manual effort and errors, increase reporting timeliness, and present consistently reliable metrics in Power BI dashboards.

- **Scalable Data Platform:** The enhanced data and reporting architecture will be scalable to integrate future data sources and support evolving business needs, positioning the organization for continuous analytics maturity and future growth.

- **Improved Strategic Decision-Making:** With consistent, comprehensive L2A and CAC KPIs presented through clear, user-friendly dashboards, leadership will be equipped to make faster, more informed business decisions, reducing risk and increasing agility.

- **Churn Prevention Insights:** Enhanced reporting will also surface early indicators of potential client attrition, allowing the team to implement targeted retention strategies and strengthen ongoing client relationships.

These outcomes will be measured through key performance indicators such as improved Lead-to-AUM conversion rates, more accurate calculation and reduction of Customer Acquisition Costs, and demonstrable adoption and utilization of enhanced Power BI reporting by leadership and marketing teams.
